(2) The REFINEMENT -- 'this row does NOT become CONFORMS under any resolution of GR19, because the grammar half stays NOT-IMPLEMENTED independently' -- rests entirely on that vanished premise and would have held a closable row open; it is withdrawn. BoundKeyedDeleteFile now carries Override, KeyedIoBinder sets it (GR12's as-if duplication carries the phrase onto every name in the list), and it reaches the runtime, where the ONE place the GR19 validated set is defined -- ValidateFixedFileAttributes -- consults it. BOTH HALVES OF GR18 NOW HOLD: the match-or-'39' branch is satisfied because the validated set is EMPTY by the A.1 item 50 determination, so '39' is unreachable BY DEFINITION rather than by omission; and the OVERRIDE branch is a real bypass rather than a coincidence, so a future non-empty set is a change to one method instead of a silent behaviour change for every program that wrote OVERRIDE to opt out.
